ns2:course.label: Drawing and Modeling
ns2:course.description: Introduction to the architectural graphic communication skills that architects use to visualize, analyze, and record creative thoughts: freehand sketching, architectural delineation, and digital applications. Prerequisite: ARCH 171 or consent of instructor. Concurrent enrollment in ARCH 231 or consent of instructor.
